report:
Reviewed all four implementation entries and three tests for normalization_demand. The complete claim requires preserving alias identity until demanded, revealability as canonical input, projection reads limited to the fixed trait/item, applicable headers, selected values and necessary predicates, and exclusion of unrelated impls and bodies. This is a partially realized destination with explicit reveal/index deferrals.

The associated solve_query entry dispatches Normalize as a distinct input-only operation. Its solve_normalize_frame implementation currently handles associated projections, returns uncertainty for named/opaque aliases and unsupported item arguments, prepares headers before matching, proves candidate conditions, and only then calls load_prepared_associated_value on a successful candidate. A mismatched header never loads its associated value. Environment normalization facts preserve a nested alias as the value rather than recursively erasing it. Captured canonical and boundary alias-copy helpers preserve Named/Associated/Opaque identities and arguments structurally; this is not evidence that opaque reveal context is operational.

The associated clauses.rs loader requests exactly (impl, associated-item) from either local or external storage and copies the value using the prepared candidate's generic mapping. Captured external_associated_type_value uses the two identities as metadata keys and imports a complete value using the relevant impl binder; no body request occurs in this helper. The local_impl_associated_type_value entry resolves the requested item by kind/name/occurrence through the canonical keyed producer, rejects unsupported GAT/where-clause/attributed values, and checks just its type using impl signature generics. Captured associated.rs shows the keyed producer scans the owner's coarse item CST to find one matching item, mints that item through the same producer used by aggregate enumeration, and does not check sibling bodies or lower their values. Source scanning/backdating must not be confused with already having every future fine-grained input boundary.

The fourth implementation entry explicitly defers named alias expansion, opaque reveal context, and excluding unrelated local impl identity reads until local_index_firewall. Current local candidate discovery still scans module impl identities, so the absolute no-unrelated-impl portion is not complete. Captured solver-guide and associated-type-normalization RFD explicitly scope the landed slice to associated projections and provisional local discovery. Reveal-aware canonical inputs and inside/outside opaque behavior remain unimplemented rather than being approved by this report.

Read each complete test and captured fixtures, trait/member lookup helpers, and query logging implementation. local_normalization_reads_one_keyed_value_without_impl_item_enumeration uses two impl headers differing in trait argument plus sibling values. It checks Yes; exactly one value and keyed-item execution cold; no aggregate impl-items lowering; no value execution warm; keyed-item revalidation but no requested-value execution after editing the sibling value; and reuse of the canonical producer after prior aggregate enumeration in a fresh database. The log records WillExecute events and is drained between stages, so these are execution/revalidation assertions, not proof that cached queries were never requested. It does not check exact normalized i32 or comprehensive forbidden-body and unrelated-impl reads. nested_associated_value_remains_a_normalizable_alias obtains symbols from source, supplies constructed normalization assumptions, requires Outer normalization to retain the Inner associated identity, and separately requires Inner normalization to return i32. This is focused solver/boundary evidence using constructed facts, not a source-level impl-value or opaque reveal test.

The semantic_spec TODO retains named/associated/opaque fold/canonical round trips, reveal-context distinctions, and full relevant-header/value versus sibling/unrelated/body trace exclusions. Prerequisites are named/opaque operational semantics with explicit reveal input, the private local index already named in the implementation TODO, and source/trace fixtures exercising those paths. Existing tests discharge only their narrower assertions; they do not erase the deferred matrix. No edits or test execution in this review; commands were fresh review start/read and source inspection before record. No additional requested edits.
